ourGain.point: Clamp vs yoke chooser: clamp for a hands-free wait (youth hunters, long sits), yoke when you must lift the crossbow off fast
Height bands from maker specs: Axis 25-40 in is seated-only, DeathGrip 7-59 in covers floor to standing, Primos and Quest reach 62 in
Crossbow tips nose-up in the clamp (butt-heavy): clamp at the balance point and set tilt tension
Ground-blind floor space: the Axis uses under half the floor space of competitors; owners say the DeathGrip is hard to fit in a small blind
